text:
marco_account: Heads up — gov customer wants POC in an isolated DC. Requirements: CycloneDX SBOM for every bundle, detached COSE signature, chunked sideload transport (no single file >2GB), 36mo retention, zero outbound DNS, and a written cost estimate for packaging + signing. Can we support?

lara_se: short: yes. we can emit CycloneDX 1.4 SBOMs and a detached COSE0 signature for each bundle. chunking: we produce N gzipped chunks + chunk-manifest.json with per-chunk sha256. transfer via scp to a jumpbox or physical media.

sam_ops: airgap-agent v1.8 will validate chunk manifest and reassemble locally; it verifies COSE signature against our pubkey. delta updates supported but must be consecutive versions (we don\'t do arbitrary binary diffs).

cert-bot: NOTE: repo signing key rotation planned 2026-07-15 UTC. for sealed customers we can provide a pinned public key + notarized fingerprint in the SOW.

lara_se: example (trimmed) SBOM + detached sig:```
{
  "bomFormat": "CycloneDX",
  "specVersion": "1.4",
  "version": 1,
  "components": [ { "name": "redwood-runtime", "version": "2.5.0" } ],
  "serialNumber": "urn:uuid:...",
  "metadata": { "timestamp": "2026-03-10T14:22:00Z" }
}
```
Signature file: bundle.tar.gz.cose (detached COSE0, alg=ES256)

lara_se: verification steps for customer security team:
1) compute sha256 per chunk and compare to chunk-manifest.json
2) reassemble chunks -> bundle.tar.gz and compute final bom_sha256
3) verify COSE signature: cose_verify(pubkey, bundle.tar.gz, bundle.tar.gz.cose)
4) validate CycloneDX schema and ensure component versions match SBOM

marco_account: good. cost questions: they want a line item for one-time packaging setup, monthly cadence support vs quarterly, and HSM signing as optional.

ps_lead: rough PS numbers (for planning only): one-time packaging & jumpbox integration = $12,000; per-release airgap validation = $800; quarterly maintenance option reduces per-release fee to $500; HSM signing add-on (we manage HSM certs / on-site signing workflow) = $6,000/mo. final quote to come from finance.

compliance: quick ask: can we include an ROA attestation (execution hashes + runbook) in the bundle? customer requires runtime attestation.

lara_se: yes. we can attach an attestation.json (execution SHA256 list + signer) as part of the SBOM metadata. also support notarization by a third-party auditor for extra fee.

sam_ops: rollback runbook (mini):```
# on airgap jumpbox
scp user@jumpbox:/tmp/bundle.part* /opt/airgap/incoming/
airgap-agent verify --manifest /opt/airgap/incoming/chunk-manifest.json
airgap-agent apply --bundle /opt/airgap/incoming/bundle.tar.gz --rollback-if-fail
```
If patch fails, agent will attempt previous bundle restore (requires previous bundle present).

marco_account: perfect. I\'ll get their security reviewer contact and ask about HSM necessity and whether they can allow egress to one IP for activation.

ps_lead: note for sales: if they want us to host their on-prem public key for automated activation, that is architecturally possible but requires a signed SLA + extra monitoring fee.

cert-bot: Packaging checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/airgap-packaging-checklist (access by SSO) :package:

marco_account: thanks all — please keep the cost bullets and the SBOM snippet in the one-pager. I\'ll loop legal and compliance after I hear back.

lara_se: will draft one-pager with bullet costs + verification flow and paste back here in ~3h.

compliance: i\'ll prepare standard attestation language and T&Cs for 36mo retention.

marco_account: closing for now, will reopen when customer responds. :white_check_mark:
